title: CODFISH CONES
instructions: --When it is not convenient to make and preparation into shapes, dip them into egg beaten with cream, then in sifted bread-crumbs and let them stand for half an hour or so to dry; then fry them a delicate color after plunging into boiling lard. Take them out, drain, place on a napkin on a dish and serve. The remainder of the chicken stock may be used for making consomme or soup.
